name: Great Lakes Fish and Wildlife Restoration Act grants
summary: Annual federal call funding restoration, research and regional projects for fish and wildlife and their habitats in the Great Lakes Basin, with pre-proposals followed by full proposals.

eligibility.rule: Keep activities within the Great Lakes Basin or affect species present there
Register in SAM.gov before applying unless applying as a natural person
Do not request funding to develop management plans, except eligible information gathering or implementation
Invited full proposals obtain sponsorship through a Proposal Review Committee member

documents: One-page resume or CV for each applicant

applicant_types.quote: Individuals Other Unrestricted Business Small businesses Education Public and state institutions of higher education Independent school districts Private institutions of higher education Government State governments City or township governments Special district governments Federally recognized Native American tribal governments County governments Nonprofit Other Native American tribal organization

geography.quote: The proposal activities (e.g., habitat restoration and barrier removal) must be within the Great Lakes Basin or impact a fish or wildlife species

access.quote: Go to www.grants.gov to apply, track application status, and subscribe to updates.

co_finance_required.quote: Not less than 25% of the total cost of implementing a proposal shall be paid in cash or inkind contributions by non-Federal sources.

effort.quote: Restoration and Research PreProposals and Regional Project Proposals Due August 3, 2026

If your restoration and research pre-proposal is selected for full proposal submission, your full proposal must be submitted in GrantSolutions (https://home.grantsolutions.gov/home/) by Tuesday, October 13, 2026, before 11:59 PM ET.

eligibility.quote: The proposal activities (e.g., habitat restoration and barrier removal) must be within the Great Lakes Basin or impact a fish or wildlife species (e.g., research, assessment) present in the Great Lakes Basin to be eligible for funding.
Before applying, all applicants except individuals applying as a natural person must be registered in SAM.gov.

The development of management plans is not eligible for funding; however, gathering important information for the development of management plans and implementing actions listed in management plans are eligible for funding.

If you get invited to submit a restoration and research full proposal, the GLFWRA Coordinator will provide contact information for a PRC member, so you can discuss your full proposal, and obtain required sponsorship to be eligible to receive funding.

co_finance.quote: The required non-federal match is 25% of the total proposal costs (funding request + non-federal match).

after_award.quote: Submit Federal Financial reports and Program Performance reports.

documents.quote: Resume/Curriculum vitae: Include 1 page resume or curriculum vitae (CV) for each applicant(s) listed above that focus on relevant and recent work.
